Name: Pastel Recolor for Compact Bathroom
Author: ghallowscalibrator
Description:
I absolutely love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1626]Compact Bathroom[/url] mod, but I wanted to have some lighter colors, so I decided to give recoloring it a go. This is actually the first recolor I've ever done for Stardew Valley, but I think it turned out pretty well, so I figured I'd upload it in case anyone else might like it.

Full credit for the mod goes to Prismuth, and you must have the Compact Bathroom mod itself installed for this to work! All I did was recolor it.
